main_text.head: DE BAPTISMO.
main_text.l: 2. Qui sint fines Baptismi: seu, ad quid sit institutus.
8. Quomodo Baptismus cum Circumcisione convenias, & quidab ea differat.
main_text.head: I. Quid sit Baptismus.
main_text.p: Baptismus est externum lauacrum institutum à Filio dei cum pronunciatione verborum, Baptizo te in nomine Patris & Filij & Spiritus sancti, ut sit testimonium eum qui sic mergitur vel tingitur reconciliari propter Christum per fidem, & sanctificari à Spiritu ad vitam æternam. Profecti (inquit Christus) docete omnes gentes, Baptizantes eos in nomine Patris, Filij, & Spiritus Sancti. Commodè definiri potest & hoc modo, Baptismus est ceremonia instituta à Christo in novo Testamento, qua abluimur aqua in nomine Patris, Filij, & Spiritus Sancti, ad significandum nos recipi in gratiam pro-pter effusum pro nobis sanguinem Christi, & regenerari ipsius Spiritu, & ad obligandos nos ut velimus deinceps factis & reipsa testari novitatem vitæ. Dicimur in gratiam recipi propter sanguinem Christi pro nobis effusum, scilicet in cruce, id est, propter totam humiliationem Christi fide nobis applicatam.
Ob. Baptismus dicitur externum aquæ lauacrum. Ergo Baptismus tantum est nudum signum. Resp. Est fallacia divisionis, Quia cum dicimus baptismum esse signum

page.notes: Woodcut frame with a large Q at the upper left; it is the initial of "Quæstiones", so the word is written whole. The printed first word reads "Vęstiones", which is the same word with the woodcut letter missing. The word "quidab" in item 8 appears printed without a space; kept as seen, but the spacing is uncertain. The heading "I. Quid sit Baptismus." is treated as a level 2 heading inside the division. Decorative dots and marks in the right margin are not text. The line break in "Bap-tismo" and "Instituti-onis" is taken from the printed hyphens.
